title: Introduce response_offramp for graceful schema failures and OpenAI-compat shim
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Streaming responses that must satisfy a JSON Schema present a challenge when mid-stream validation fails or downstream tool-calls are triggered. Existing approaches either abruptly terminate the stream (breaking client parsers) or attempt heavy-weight rollbacks. This PR introduces a lightweight 'response_offramp' mechanism plus an OpenAI-compatibility shim to ensure predictable, client-friendly behavior for schema violations and function-call boundaries.

What it does (high level): Adds a new response_format variant (response_format="json_offramp") and a runtime offramp code path that emits a compact final envelope when schema enforcement fails in streaming mode. The envelope contains a concise error_code, user-facing message, and minimal diagnostic hints (schema_path and validation_summary). OpenAI-compat adapter maps the envelope to a final chunk with finish_reason set to "schema_error_offramp" and a small, parsable metadata payload so existing OpenAI-based clients can detect and handle schema failures without crashing.

Key user-facing changes: - New response_format option: json_offramp (fallback semantics documented) - New SDK surface: `Stream.onOfframp()` (Python/TS/Go SDKs updated) - OpenAI-compat shim will translate offramp envelopes into a single final SSE/event payload with explicit finish_reason for backward compatibility - A non-strict path is still available: strict_mode="off" (previous default), strict_mode="error" (current strict), strict_mode="offramp" (new; emits envelope and marks generation complete).

Implementation notes: - Runtime: added an offramp emission stage in streaming state machine; when validator detects an unrecoverable schema mismatch after the streaming commit point, it switches to the offramp stage instead of hard-closing the stream. - Validator: lightweight incremental validator now tracks schema_path of first failing token and composes a short validation_summary rather than full diff to keep wire payload small. - Toolcall anchoring: when a tool call is in-flight, the offramp includes a tool_anchor field so callers can deterministically decide whether to retry, abort, or invoke the tool with partial context. - OpenAI-compat adapter: implements deterministic mapping of offramp envelope to an SSE final chunk compatible with common OpenAI client expectations. - Telemetry: new metrics (offramp.count, offramp.latency, offramp.by_schema) and an example dashboard were added.

Backward compatibility and migration: Existing clients are unaffected by default. The new behavior is opt-in via response_format or strict_mode. OpenAI-compat clients receive a clear finish_reason so existing parsers can detect and surface user-friendly messages instead of failing with truncated JSON.

Testing and rollout: Unit and integration tests added for streaming validator, offramp envelope composition, SDK callbacks, and OpenAI-compat mapping. Canary rollout on Dedicated region eu-west-1 for 48 hours followed by global rollout.

Related work: complements ENG-8470 (stream-snapshot-repair) and PM-431 (structured-output-ux), addresses several incidents where client parsers crashed due to abrupt stream termination (SUP-1291).

review_comments: Connor Liu: Please ensure offramp envelopes are under 1KB — clients in low-bandwidth mobile scenarios need a small payload. Suggest truncating validation_summary and sending a link to verbose diagnostics in the console.
Aisha Patel: Implemented size cap and added telemetry link for verbose diagnostics (see telemetry change).
María Gomez: Can we make the default strict_mode remain unchanged? We should not surprise users. Also request explicit doc note for SDK de-serialization behavior.
Aisha Patel: Kept default unchanged and added migration guide + SDK behavior notes.

release_notes: Added opt-in response_format="json_offramp" and strict_mode="offramp" to emit compact schema-error envelopes for streaming responses; OpenAI-compat adapter maps these to finish_reason="schema_error_offramp". SDKs expose onOfframp/on_offramp hooks. Opt-in only; default behavior unchanged.
